title: Certified rational-anchor filtering for exact GPU scans of power-residue runs
summary: We study exact longest monochromatic runs of power-residue colourings, including neutral prefixes and least canonical witnesses. A certified rational cover represents every relevant interval inside a short signed character table. A reflection-compatible schedule retains an anchor; conservative filters reject only known contradictions, bilateral completion recovers the full run, and tie-preserving reduction selects its least witness.
